opportunities.name: Book unit research: Gutenberg + IMDb film lookup, logged to notes
opportunities.description: For a book title, look up it on Project Gutenberg (author, downloads), find the film adaptation on IMDb (year, rating), and append a 'Unit:' note.
steps: Search the book title in Project Gutenberg quick search
Open the top result and read author and download count
Search the same title on IMDb and open the top film result
Read the film year and rating
Open Notes and add a note: 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>'

opportunities.name: Country geography research: Wikipedia + timeanddate, logged to notes
opportunities.description: For a country, get its facts from Wikipedia, the capital's current local time from timeanddate, and append a 'Geography:' note.
steps: Search the country on Wikipedia and read capital, population, languages, currency
Search the capital on timeanddate and open the country's capital result
Open Notes and add 'Geography: <country>, capital <capital>, pop <pop>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time>'
